notices.confirm:
Hello,

the First Move assistant received your message. It answers with AI, so it needs your confirmation once before it reads anything:

{link}

By confirming you accept the Terms ({terms}) and emails about your request. No marketing.

Your message waits up to {days} days for your confirmation. If you did not write to us, ignore this email: nothing is processed.

First Move
notices.warning:
Hello,

the First Move assistant only helps with First Move: the Quick Check, the Business Plan and fifth-generation district heating and cooling. Your message was not answered.

Please keep to these topics. After one more such message, this address is paused for {days} days.

First Move
